name: K3_CFG_CameraOnIsMetal
comment: TRUE = camera output ON means metal; FALSE = ON means plastic. Not yet verified

name: K3_CFG_Tray2Extended
comment: TRUE = at Tray 2 the head must go out before dropping. Not yet verified

name: K3_CFG_EStopFitted
comment: FALSE only for bench tests with no E-stop on DI-12

name: K3_CFG_EStopNC
comment: TRUE = E-stop contact is on when released

comment: Wait after vacuum on before lifting

name: K3_T_Release
comment: Wait after vacuum off before moving

name: K3_T_EmptyDebounce
comment: Magazine empty this long ends the batch

comment: TRUE once homing has finished; the home coils are then held in Idle

name: rotEnable
comment: TRUE once the head is in: only then may the rotary coils switch on
